name: Customer Support Ticket Triage & Routing Agent

parameters.formDescription: Submit your support request and our team will get back to you shortly.

nodes.name: Support Ticket Form
nodes.notes: INPUT (tool use): public web form. Collects name, email, ticket message, optional product area. This is the entry trigger of the workflow.

nodes.name: Validate Input
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC fallback gate. TRUE = message present -> continue. FALSE = missing message -> safe fallback path (workflow does not break).

assignments.name: next_action
assignments.value: Ask the customer to resubmit the form including a description of their issue.

nodes.name: Fallback: Missing Message
nodes.notes: FALLBACK / ERROR HANDLING for missing input. Produces a clean rejection record instead of crashing the run.

nodes.name: OpenAI Model (Classifier)
nodes.notes: LLM brain for the Classifier agent. temperature 0 for stable, repeatable labels.

nodes.name: Classifier Output Parser
nodes.notes: STRUCTURED OUTPUT. Forces the Classifier to return strict JSON: { category, sentiment }.

parameters.text:
=You are a SUPPORT TICKET CLASSIFIER agent.
Classify the ticket below.

Rules:
- category MUST be exactly one of: Billing, Technical, Account, General.
- sentiment MUST be exactly one of: positive, neutral, negative.
- Use the product-area hint only as a weak signal; the message text wins.
- Return ONLY the JSON described by the format instructions. No prose.

Product area hint: {{ $('Support Ticket Form').item.json['Product Area'] || 'none' }}

Ticket message:
"""
{{ $('Support Ticket Form').item.json['Ticket Message'] }}
"""

nodes.name: Classifier (AI)
nodes.notes: AI ROLE #1 - CLASSIFIER. Decides category + sentiment. On failure: retries, then continues so the Priority Scorer can apply safe defaults.

nodes.name: OpenAI Model (Extractor)
nodes.notes: LLM brain for the Extractor agent.

nodes.name: Extractor Output Parser
nodes.notes: STRUCTURED OUTPUT. Forces { summary, issue_keywords[], customer_intent }.

parameters.text:
=You are a SUPPORT TICKET EXTRACTOR agent.
From the ticket message, extract structured details.

Rules:
- summary: 1-2 neutral sentences, no opinions.
- issue_keywords: 2-6 short lowercase keywords/phrases pulled from the message.
- customer_intent: one sentence describing what the customer wants to happen.
- Return ONLY the JSON described by the format instructions.

Ticket message:
"""
{{ $('Support Ticket Form').item.json['Ticket Message'] }}
"""

nodes.name: Extractor (AI)
nodes.notes: AI ROLE #2 - EXTRACTOR. Pulls summary, keywords, and intent. On failure: retries, then continues with safe defaults downstream.

nodes.name: Priority Scorer
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC. Computes priority_score (0-100) and priority_level (High/Medium/Low) from category + sentiment + urgency keywords. Also applies AI fallbacks and builds the single ticket record used downstream.

nodes.name: Route by Category
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC ROUTING. Sends the ticket down the branch matching its category -> the right team.

nodes.name: Billing Team
nodes.notes: Billing branch label. Canonical team data lives on the Priority Scorer record.

nodes.name: Tech Team
nodes.notes: Technical branch label.

nodes.name: Account Team
nodes.notes: Account branch label.

nodes.name: General Queue
nodes.notes: General branch label.

nodes.name: Escalation Check
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC. TRUE if priority is High OR sentiment is negative -> human review. FALSE -> straight to auto-acknowledgement.

parameters.subject: =[Approval needed] {{ $('Priority Scorer').item.json.priority_level }} ticket from {{ $('Priority Scorer').item.json.customer_name }}

nodes.name: Human Approval
nodes.notes: HUMAN-IN-THE-LOOP (Send and Wait for Approval). Pauses the run and emails a support lead Approve/Disapprove buttons for risky/high-priority tickets.

nodes.name: OpenAI Model (Response Writer)
nodes.notes: LLM brain for the Response Writer. Slightly higher temperature for natural, warm wording.

parameters.text:
=You are a CUSTOMER SUPPORT RESPONSE WRITER agent.
Write a short, warm acknowledgement email body in plain text (4-7 sentences).

Context (do not invent anything beyond this):
- Customer name: {{ $('Priority Scorer').item.json.customer_name }}
- Issue summary: {{ $('Priority Scorer').item.json.summary }}
- Category: {{ $('Priority Scorer').item.json.category }} (handled by {{ $('Priority Scorer').item.json.team_label }})
- Priority level: {{ $('Priority Scorer').item.json.priority_level }}

Guidelines:
- Greet the customer by name.
- Confirm we received the request and briefly restate the issue.
- Say which team is handling it and give a realistic next step (High = within a few hours, Medium = within 1 business day, Low = within 2-3 business days).
- Be empathetic if the issue is frustrating. Do not promise refunds or specific outcomes.
- Sign off as 'The Support Team'.
- Output ONLY the email body text.

nodes.name: Response Writer (AI)
nodes.notes: AI ROLE #3 - RESPONSE WRITER. Drafts the personalised acknowledgement email body. Output is at {{ $json.text }}.

parameters.subject: =We received your support request ({{ $('Priority Scorer').item.json.category }}) - {{ $('Priority Scorer').item.json.ticket_id }}

nodes.name: Send Acknowledgement
nodes.notes: TOOL USE (email). Sends the AI-drafted acknowledgement to the customer. Includes a hard-coded fallback body if the AI step returned nothing.

nodes.name: Log to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: TOOL USE (database/log). Appends one row per ticket: name, email, category, priority, team, timestamp. This is the durable ticket record.
